answer: An identity must hold an inlet lane on the bridge. The inlet registry gives one lane to each identity key, and each lane locks a 70 bond. Each epoch the lane must send a whisper heartbeat signed by its lane key; bridge auditors burn bonds with a missing, duplicated, or foreign-signed whisper. Per operator, the k-th lane costs 70 plus 25 times k minus 1, so 1,000 fakes cost 12,557,500 credits, no sharing, no discount. A rented lane farm fails: its whisper key still belongs to its owner; one key answering for two lanes burns both bonds. An honest agent pays 70 once, refunded after a clean epoch.
